ScalarCase.description: One rule of a condition column: when it holds, the shot gets its label.

when.description: The rule, over the symbols in inputs: comparisons < <= > >= == !=, ranges like '4.0 <= x <= 6.5', and/or/not, e.g. 'x > 10 and y < 2'. Rules are checked top to bottom; the first one that holds wins.
when.title: When

label.description: What it means, as pages show it, e.g. 'Al foil in beam'. The s-file stores the case's number (0 for the first case, 1 for the next, ...).
label.title: Label

ScalarCase.title: ScalarCase

ScalarColumn.description: One new s-file column: a formula, or condition rules, over existing columns.

name.description: The new column's name in the s-file, units included if you like, e.g. 'UC_TopView x (mm)'. It must not be one of the scanner's own columns: a job never overwrites raw data.
name.title: Name

inputs.description: The columns this column reads, each under a short symbol: symbol → existing s-file column, e.g. {x: 'UC_TopView centroid_x'}. Both kinds use them: a formula's expr and a condition's rules name the symbols. A column made earlier in this job may be used by its name.
inputs.title: Inputs

expr.description: The formula, e.g. 'x * 0.0244' or 'a * b / c'. Numbers, the symbols in inputs, + - * / ** %, comparisons (1 where true, 0 where false), and/or/not, the shot-by-shot functions abs, sqrt, exp, log, log10, sin, cos, tan, arcsin, arccos, arctan, arctan2, hypot, minimum, maximum (and pi, e), and the column functions mean, median, std, min, max (one input, over all the scan's shots: x - mean(x)). For a column of kind formula; a condition has cases instead.
expr.title: Expr

cases.description: For a column of kind condition: rules checked in order, each with a label, e.g. when '4.0 <= x <= 6.5' → 'Al foil'. The first rule that holds wins; a shot missing an input is unknown. The Images page lists the scan's label at the top.
cases.title: Cases

otherwise.description: With cases: the label for a shot no rule matches (stored as the number after the last case). Defaults to 'other'.
otherwise.title: Otherwise

ScalarColumn.title: ScalarColumn

ScalarJobRuntime.description: How the job runs among a group's analyses.

priority.description: Run order within a group: lower runs first. The default, 1000, runs after the recipes whose columns a formula may read.
priority.title: Priority

ScalarJobRuntime.title: ScalarJobRuntime

description:
New s-file columns computed from existing ones, shot by shot.

The file's stem is the ID groups and the portal refer to.  The job's
product is its columns, merged into the s-file under the shared lock;
under ``analysis/ScanNNN/`` it writes only its scalar sidecar and, for
condition columns, their labels.

schema_version.description: Format version of this job file. Leave at 1 — tools update this automatically when the file format changes.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

kind.description: scalar_columns: compute new s-file columns from existing ones.
kind.title: Kind

columns.description: The new columns, evaluated in this order.
columns.title: Columns

output_name.description: Label the portal's Analysis tab lists the job under. Defaults to the file name.
output_name.title: Output Name

title: ScalarJob
